title: Agent config
description: Provider-agnostic LLM settings for the extractor/validator agents. Provider/model/api-key env var are config, not code — any litellm-supported provider is a config change.

provider.description: litellm provider key, e.g. nvidia_nim, openai, anthropic, groq, ollama, together_ai, bedrock, or openai-compatible

model.description: Model name as litellm expects it for the provider (provider-specific)

api_key_env.description: Environment variable holding the API key; empty string means no key (local providers like ollama)

api_base.description: Optional custom base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints (e.g. local vLLM/LM Studio); null = provider default

timeout_seconds.description: Timeout in seconds for each LLM API call. Prevents indefinite hangs on slow/stuck responses.

tool_choice.description: tool_choice for the structured-output tool call

parse_retry.description: Bounded parse-retry budget (default 1): retries when the model returns output that can't be parsed/validated. Format recovery only — not a content repair.

min_confidence.description: Extraction results below this confidence are invalid and go through the retry-then-flag policy (Spec req. 9)

repair_budget.description: Bounded semantic repair budget (default 1): one re-extraction with validation errors, then flag (Rule 5). Total semantic repair attempts per record is exactly this budget.
